achievement.csv.column: 3 (zero-based logical column; row ID precedes column 0)

method.evaluation: File-backed instruction and lookup-table evaluation for every title-linked row; no target execution.

title_map_store.meaning: Static nonzero store when the loader visits the row, not observed runtime membership.

method.completion: A direct or parent ordinal is proven only when <1024 and inverse(ordinal) equals that achievement. Native result 0 alone is ambiguous.
method.parent_zero: No parent returned by 0x0070F910; null completion is not a direct-bit rejection.
